description: Export photos, optionally with a saved export preset; format/quality/width/height override only those preset settings. Skips the preset's collision prompt and after-export action. While get_photo_detail or another export runs, the call is refused, not queued: failed with nothing exported; call again once it finishes. A photo with outdated AI settings can open Lightroom's AI Updates dialog, which blocks until dismissed. Returns written files {photo_id, path}, skipped photo_ids (on_existing skip), destination and preset; a photo whose export failed before its session started is failed, and one whose session failed after it started (Cancel in "AI Updates Recommended" included) is unknown, naming the export and what it leaves on the photo (one Export history step and the exported mark); both keep the files already written; photos not reached before the time budget are remaining. Argument and overwrite refusals change nothing. Rules: give destination or export_preset; export_preset_folder needs export_preset.

destination.description: Absolute path of the export folder, created if missing; ~/ is expanded; only the platform's separator between names (/ on macOS, \ on Windows); no ., .. or empty names, no control characters. Optional if export_preset has a fixed destination

export_preset.description: Export preset title, file name, id or file path (list_export_presets)

on_existing.description: What to do when the destination already holds a file with that name (default rename). Lightroom never prompts. overwrite is refused into any catalog folder.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths to export

quality.description: JPEG quality (0-100), default 90; with a preset it overrides the preset's quality and turns off its file size limit

name: export_photos
title: Export photos
